integrity: The compatible pencil, Nijenhuis torsion, fiber decomposition, common-fiber intersection, induced parameter action, finite-field counts, and rank profiles are reconstructed directly. The packaged verifier derives the symbolic equations and exhaustively replays every projective fiber over four finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats one explicit two-dimensional compatible Leibniz pencil, not all compatible pencils.
The generic fiber [1:1] is already covered by the cited single-algebra Nijenhuis example; the new statement concerns the full pencil and its intersections.
The zeta function is for the reduced field-valued projective-incidence set.
title: Dual-number Nijenhuis phase diagram for a compatible Leibniz pencil
